criteria.justification: BrightPath offers a functional modern stack (React 17, Node.js 18, PostgreSQL on AWS), but the base architecture relies on Single-AZ RDS, basic CloudWatch monitoring without APM, and restricted read-only nightly bulk sync integrations. Advanced integrations like real-time Kafka streaming, SCIM 2.0, and event-driven messaging are explicitly excluded from the base scope.
criteria.evidence: The BrightPath procurement platform is a cloud-hosted SaaS-style application built on our standard three-tier architecture... Database: PostgreSQL 14 (AWS RDS Single-AZ)... Real-time bidirectional integration, event-driven messaging, and sub-second data synchronisation are not included in the base proposal.

criteria.justification: The proposal provides a well-defined 10-week, 6-phase schedule with clear sprint deliverables and a fully identified 6-person delivery team. However, risk management is minimal, explicitly deferring detailed milestone risk planning until after project initiation.
criteria.evidence: BrightPath proposes an accelerated 10-week delivery from kick-off to go-live... Detailed milestone risk planning will be finalised after project initiation.

criteria.justification: Pricing is clearly itemized across implementation, licensing, integration, support, and estimated pass-through AWS infrastructure. The payment schedule is tied to key project milestones, though multiple features (Multi-AZ, advanced connectors) will incur post-discovery additional costs.
criteria.evidence: TOTAL YEAR 1 (excl. GST) 408,727 (~ SGD 360,000)... Payment: 50% on kick-off, 30% on UAT sign-off, 20% on go-live.

criteria.justification: Basic controls like AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+, Auth0, and daily snapshots are covered. However, BrightPath lacks key certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS), excludes MAS TRM and PDPA compliance from the base scope, omits penetration testing, and has no dedicated security lead on the delivery team.
criteria.evidence: formal ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI-DSS certifications are not currently held. MAS TRM compliance assessment is out of scope for base proposal... Formal pen-test, MAS TRM compliance assessment, PDPA audit, SOC 2 — NOT INCLUDED in base scope

criteria.justification: BrightPath demonstrates solid experience with over 80 delivered projects and provides two relevant enterprise case studies. However, the support model is restricted to business hours via Freshdesk ticketing with a 2-business-hour P1 response time and no 24/7 or weekend coverage in the base package.
criteria.evidence: BrightPath has delivered 80+ software projects. Two enterprise references are provided... Support channel: email ticketing system (Freshdesk). No 24×7 or weekend support in base scope.

risks: Security and compliance deficiencies: Absence of ISO 27001/SOC 2 certifications and exclusion of MAS TRM compliance, PDPA audits, and penetration testing from the initial scope.
Integration scope gap: Critical real-time integrations and advanced protocols are excluded, which may lead to scope creep and added costs post-discovery.
Operational support limitations: Absence of 24/7 support coverage and business-hours-only SLAs could lead to prolonged downtime during critical platform incidents.
suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech offers an attractive, fast-paced 10-week implementation plan with transparent pricing and solid SME experience. However, the response presents notable risks regarding enterprise security certifications, regulatory compliance (MAS TRM/PDPA), base-scope architecture constraints, and business-hours-only support.
